score_gauge_explainer: This score represents the overall technical health of the website. Scores above 8 indicate strong optimization. Scores between 6 and 8 indicate moderate improvement opportunities. Scores below 6 require structural improvements.
priority_radar_explainer: This chart shows which areas require the most improvement: Performance, SEO, Accessibility, Conversion and Structure.
competitor_snapshot_explainer: This chart compares the analyzed website against selected competitors based on performance signals.
crawler_map_explainer: This map summarizes the internal structure detected by the crawler and its depth distribution.
no_competitors: No competitors were provided for benchmarking.
